observation.runTac: The merge ran as a run_tac block in each task's root state, which Lean elaborates in the declaration's own scope. Of the 276 attempts recorded, 48 did not complete their merge, and with them the latest attempt of 24 units (19 step-prover, 5 menu), all in CategoryTheory, Polynomial, and MvPolynomial modules. Each failed in 0.15 to 1.6 s whatever its number of goals, while completed merges took 1.9 s at the median, and the 24 of these units attempted twice failed both times. Replayed by hand, the block fails in CategoryTheory modules with 'Application type mismatch', because its Prod.snd resolves to CategoryTheory.Prod.snd in files that open that namespace, and in Polynomial and MvPolynomial modules with 'internal exception abortTermElab', the failure that stopped keys-v0.1's export there and made search-v0.8 define its export as a tactic right after the imports. The same code as a tactic defined after the imports, before the file's opens, completed on every unit tried. These units would have left the measured set, and C34 (98% of the merges complete) would have failed on them.
observation.runtimeExceptions: Lean 4.32's try/catch rethrows heartbeat and recursion-depth exceptions (Core.tryCatch), and a test in this project's Lean confirms it, while tryCatchRuntimeEx catches them. In the registered code an elaboration or an isDefEq check that exhausted its heartbeats would therefore have ended the whole pass, instead of counting as not elaborated or as unequal, as the preregistration states. No completed merge met one (the completed merges report 0 exhausted checks), so the completed merges are what the amended code computes.

change: goal_defeq.DEFEQ_DEFINITION defines the merge as the tactic pg_defeq_classes from the text of DEFEQ_TEMPLATE, whose two guards now use tryCatchRuntimeEx and restore the state as the backtracking try did, so that an elaboration that exhausts its heartbeats counts as not elaborated and an isDefEq check that exhausts them as unequal; its docstrings now describe the three transparencies and the hypothesis count. run_defeq_replay.DefeqSession defines pg_defeq_classes after the two export tactics, and the merge runs through it (through the run_tac block only if the definition fails; each merge records which). Each row recorded after this amendment carries 'amendment': 2. A unit whose latest attempt before the amendment did not complete its merge runs again, whatever its outcome, and attempts under the amendment count afresh (two at most); every other row is kept. The run checks the amended files against the hashes recorded here.
